mechanism_claims.claim_text: KW-23 design rationale is membrane-oriented: low cationicity and ferulic-acid hydrophobic conjugation are proposed to support electrostatic contact and membrane permeabilization.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper does not report a direct molecular target or direct membrane-disruption assay for KW-23 in Candida; this is design rationale, not direct mechanism proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: KW-23 has phenotypic antifungal/fungicidal activity against C. albicans and shows synergy/additivity with fluconazole in checkerboard assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Activity and FICI support antimicrobial effect and interaction classification, but do not by themselves establish a direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: KW-23 showed low erythrocyte hemolysis across the local Table-3 concentration series, reaching 3% at 100 µM.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Hemolysis is a toxicity/selectivity measure and is not an antifungal mechanism assay.
